backend/main.mo: Main actor with blob storage, authorization mixins, user profiles, and Nakshatra CRUD operations including new lunarClimate and karmicLesson fields; applies migration on upgrade and enforces role-based access control (admin for create/delete, user for update, public for read).
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old Nakshatra records (without lunarClimate/karmicLesson) to new format by adding default climate and lesson values for each of the 27 Nakshatras based on their names.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features: updating CurrentNakshatraBanner to display lunar climate and karmic lesson (REQ-3), and updating AdminEditPage to allow editing these new fields (REQ-4).
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and utilities; highlights initialization-aware error handling, astronomical calculations, and the cosmic dark theme design system.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables; dark theme uses cosmic aesthetic with purple/violet primary colors and cyan accents.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with 'Star Field Explorer' title, viewport meta tag, and root div mounting the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, nakshatra detail, and admin pages (wrapped in AdminGuard); includes ThemeProvider for dark mode and Toaster for notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Authentication guard component that renders PasscodeEntry if user is not authenticated, otherwise renders children; used to protect admin routes.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogoutButto: Logout button component that clears passcode auth, Internet Identity session, and React Query cache, then displays success toast.
frontend/src/components/CurrentNakshatra: Banner displaying current Moon nakshatra with expandable section showing lunar climate description, karmic lesson, and pada details; includes loading states and links to detail page.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying a "Built with caffeine.ai" attribution link with a heart icon and copyright notice for the current year.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Header component with a moon icon logo, site title, and navigation links to Nakshatras and Admin pages using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that renders Header, Footer, and an Outlet for nested routes in a flex column structure.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraGrid.ts: Grid component displaying all 27 Nakshatras as cards with images, highlighting the current moon position, and showing loading states during backend initialization.
frontend/src/components/NakshatraImageUp: Image upload component with 4:5 aspect ratio validation, preview functionality, progress tracking, and conversion of files to Uint8Array for backend storage.
frontend/src/components/PasscodeEntry.ts: Admin authentication form that validates a passcode before initiating Internet Identity authentication flow.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication and admin token initialization.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentNakshatra.t: Hook that calculates and returns the current Nakshatra based on moon position, refreshing every 5 minutes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useNakshatraMutations: React Query mutation hook for updating Nakshatra data and images, with automatic cache invalidation on success.
frontend/src/hooks/usePasscodeAuth.ts: Custom hook managing two-factor authentication combining a hardcoded passcode with Internet Identity login, using sessionStorage and custom events for cross-component state synchronization.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching Nakshatra data and images from the backend actor, with error transformation, initialization error detection, and exponential backoff retry logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a dark-themed color palette using OKLCH color space for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, and semantic colors.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminEditPage.tsx: Admin page for editing individual Nakshatra entries with form inputs for all fields including four padas, image upload functionality, and mutation handling with loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying a grid of all Nakshatras with thumbnails and edit buttons, featuring initialization state handling, error alerts, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Public-facing homepage displaying educational content about Nakshatras, a current Nakshatra banner, and a grid of all Nakshatras with initialization and error state handling.
frontend/src/pages/NakshatraDetailPage.t: Detail page component for individual Nakshatras that displays comprehensive information including pada details, uses backend data with fallback to local PADA_DATA, and handles loading/error states with retry logic.
frontend/src/utils/nakshatraEngine.ts: Core astronomical calculation engine that defines 27 Nakshatras with degree ranges, calculates Moon's ecliptic longitude using Julian Day and simplified Meeus algorithms, and determines current Nakshatra and pada from lunar position.
frontend/src/utils/padaData.ts: Static data file containing detailed pada information for all Nakshatras, including degree ranges, navamsa signs, titles, and extensive descriptions for each of the four padas per Nakshatra.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and persisting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, extended theme for shadcn/ui components, container queries, typography plugin, and custom animations for accordion components.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting a Vedic astrology app with dynamic lunar climate descriptions, existing features for CurrentNakshatraBanner and admin editing, and pending feature requests to add lunarClimate and karmicLesson fields for all 27 Nakshatras.
